title: The Hidden Side of Dubai: Life Inside a City Built on Sand
description:
Discover the hidden side of Dubai beyond the luxury hotels and futuristic skyscrapers. Learn how millions of workers, ancient traditions, and extreme desert conditions shape the true reality of a city built against the odds.

Explore the human stories and architectural marvels that define one of the most contradictory urban experiments on Earth, and understand what it really takes to survive and thrive in this extreme environment.

#dubai #documentary #desert #travel #extremelife
